unresolved.description: Report does not state a deterministic trigger for HyperCore leaving the slot inactive; the asynchronous-activation condition is represented as a grounded Boolean.
Timing of the later reverting reads relative to registration is not quantified; only the temporal qualifier 'later ... until removeSuppliedEntry clears it' is preserved.

limitations: The intent's 'remain pending' state is encoded as the negation of promotion plus the requirement that promotion implies a successful suppliedBalance read; the pending state itself is not a separate observable.
The impact statement bundles three reverting functions into one Boolean outcome.
